newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks slip in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks slip in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks slipped in early Thursday morning trade, but the losses were expected to be limited, brokers said. They said the market environment was not bad but participants were opting for the sidelines ahead of the settlement of September futures and options on Friday.
At 0019 GMT, the key Nikkei 225 average was down 127.21 points or 0.62 percent at 20,443.83. Its December futures were down 80 points at 20,510.
"The Nikkei average is glued to the 20,500 level," a manager at a medium-sized brokerage said. "Buyers are lined lower down so there is little fear of a plunge."
